name: xbloom-ai-brew-studio
description: xBloom AI 冲煮工作台 —— LLM 配方生成 / 云端同步 / BLE 实验

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run dev --workspace server
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run test --workspace server
scripts.test:web: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run test --workspace web
scripts.test:all: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace web
scripts.verify:cloudflare: npm ci --prefix cloudflare && npm --prefix cloudflare test && npm --prefix cloudflare run check
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run check:release && npm run test:all && npm run build && npm run verify:cloudflare
